latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of mcporter.

- Provides a CLI to manage and interact with MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and tools.
- Supports listing servers, authentication, calling MCP tools, and managing configuration.
- Adds Homebrew installation instructions and OS support details.
- Includes commands for generating CLI/type wrappers for MCP tools.
- Improved usage documentation with updated homepage and clearer command examples.
